01 / Sales Analysis Dashboard

An interactive sales analysis project exploring revenue, profit, product and category performance, time trends, geographic sales, shipping preferences, and customer retention.

Power BIPythonSales KPIsCustomer Cohorts
01
S · SITUATION

Sales data can be difficult to interpret across products, regions, categories, and time periods when key metrics are spread across multiple views.

T · TASK

Create a clear dashboard to summarize sales performance, profitability, customer retention, and shipping patterns.

A · ACTION

Used Power BI and Python in the project workflow to explore KPIs, compare product and category sales, review trends, and visualize cohort retention.

R · RESULT

Produced an interactive multi-view dashboard covering sales, profit, quantity, top products, regional performance, trends, and retention. The visuals make the main patterns easier to explore.

Top products, categories, and subcategories
Sales and profitability trends over time
Customer cohorts and retention curve
Geographic performance and shipping mode adoption

02 / Customer Churn Analysis & Prediction

A customer analytics project exploring churn patterns across customer demographics, tenure, contracts, payment methods, and services, alongside a prediction view highlighting customers identified as at risk.

SQLPower BIPythonMachine Learning
02
S · SITUATION

Customer churn can be influenced by different factors, making it useful to examine how churn varies across customer groups and service choices.

T · TASK

Analyze churn patterns and present a prediction view that helps identify customers flagged as potentially at risk.

A · ACTION

Used SQL, Power BI, and Python with machine-learning techniques in the project workflow to organize customer data, explore churn segments, and display prediction results.

R · RESULT

Created summary and prediction dashboards showing churn rate, customer segments, contract and payment patterns, and a table of customers flagged as at risk.

Churn rate and customer segment analysis
Contract, payment, tenure, and service patterns
Prediction dashboard and at-risk customer view
Visual summaries to support customer-retention decisions
